theorem lg_target (p : ℝ) (h0 : 0 ≤ p) (h1 : p ≤ 1) : p * (1 - p) ≤ 1 / 4 := by
  have h2 : 0 ≤ 1 - p := by
    rw [sub_le_zero_iff]
    exact le_add_right (le_refl 1) p
  calc
    p * (1 - p) ≤ ((p + (1 - p)) / 2) ^ 2 * 4 :
      by {
        apply Real.add_rpow_le_rpow_add,
        exact h0,
        exact h2,
        exact le_one (add_nonneg h0 h2)
      }
    ... = (1 / 2) ^ 2 * 4 :
      by {
        rw [add_left_cancel, add_right_cancel, mul_div_and_div_mul]
        rw [one_div, one_div, mul_one, one_div, one_div]
        rw [mul_assoc, mul_one]
        rw [one_div, one_div, mul_one, one_div, one_div]
        rw [mul_assoc, mul_one]
        rw [mul_one]
      }
    ... = 1 :
      by simp [mul_one]
